title: Checkout API returning high number of 500 errors
description: Checkout requests are failing with HTTP 500 errors and latency has increased significantly. Customers are unable to complete purchases.
expected_action: Increase database connection pool capacity, investigate connection leaks, and restart affected checkout instances if required.

title: Intermittent order creation failures
description: Order creation is intermittently failing. Application logs show dependency errors and users are receiving failed order responses.
expected_action: Restore Redis connectivity, verify cache health, and validate order creation after recovery.

title: Payment requests timing out
description: Payment requests are timing out when communicating with the external payment gateway. Transaction completion rates have dropped.
expected_action: Verify payment gateway health, enable or validate retry/fallback behavior, and monitor transaction success rate.

title: User profile requests are slow
description: User profile APIs are responding slowly and request latency has increased. No significant increase in application errors has been observed.
expected_action: Investigate database query latency and active connections, identify slow queries, and optimize or scale the affected database workload.

title: Inventory API returning dependency errors
description: Inventory lookups are failing because the service is receiving errors from a downstream inventory dependency.
expected_action: Check downstream dependency health, validate connectivity, and use fallback or retry behavior where supported.

title: Notifications are significantly delayed
description: Email and notification delivery is delayed. Messages are accumulating in the messaging system and consumers are processing messages slower than normal.
expected_action: Investigate queue depth and consumer health, scale consumers if appropriate, and monitor backlog recovery.

title: Search requests are slow and failing
description: Search API latency has increased and some requests are failing. Search cluster health indicators show degradation.
expected_action: Inspect search cluster health, identify unhealthy nodes or resource pressure, and recover or scale the affected cluster.

title: Authentication requests are failing
description: Users are unable to authenticate reliably. Authentication requests are returning dependency-related failures.
expected_action: Check identity provider and token service health, validate connectivity, and restore the dependency before retrying authentication.

title: Recommendation API response time increased
description: Recommendation requests have become slow. CPU and memory utilization on recommendation service instances are significantly higher than normal.
expected_action: Identify resource-intensive workloads, scale affected instances, and investigate the workload causing sustained resource saturation.

title: Checkout errors increased after deployment
description: Checkout failures increased shortly after a new application deployment. The previous release did not show the same error pattern.
expected_action: Compare the current deployment configuration with the previous version and roll back the release if the regression is confirmed.

title: Order service experiencing intermittent failures
description: Order creation failures have been reported, but the available incident description does not provide enough information to determine whether the issue is application, database, cache, or downstream dependency related.
expected_action: Ask for additional context such as representative request IDs, error messages, affected endpoints, or dependency details before proposing remediation.

title: Payment failures with conflicting evidence
description: Payment failures are occurring, but available evidence indicates both external gateway latency and internal application resource pressure. The evidence is insufficient to confidently identify a single root cause.
expected_action: Report uncertainty, identify the conflicting evidence, and request additional investigation before executing a potentially unsafe remediation.
